<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[Nigeria]] bans international [[humanitarian organization]] [[Action Against Hunger]] for allegedly providing food and medicine for [[Boko Haram]] militants in the north-east of the country. Action Against Hunger denies the [[Nigerian military]]'s accusations. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-49767289 (BBC News)] [https://www.africanews.com/2019/09/20/nigeria-bans-ngo-for-aiding-boko-haram-islamic-state/ (Africanews)]
*[[2019 Karbala bombing]]
**A bomb explodes onboard a minibus at a [[security checkpoint]] near [[Karbala]], [[Iraq]], killing 12 civilians. [https://www.sfgate.com/news/article/Iraq-Minibus-explosion-outside-Karbala-kills-8-14455903.php (SFGate)]
;Arts and culture
*Under pressure from owner [[Hasbro]], the next [[Brussels]] [[List of licensed and localized editions of Monopoly: Europe#City_Editions|edition]] of the ''[[Monopoly (game)|Monopoly]]'' board game [[Censorship|censors]] [[Manneken Pis]], the 17th-century bronze statue of a naked boy urinating, with swimming trunks. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/09/20/monopoly-censor-belgiums-manneken-pis-brussels-edition-box/ (''The Telegraph'')]
;Business and economy
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**The [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] lifts [[tariff]]s on 437 goods, amid talks. Chinese officials cancel a planned farm visit to return to China earlier. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-china/u-s-lifts-tariffs-on-400-chinese-products-trump-cites-trade-progress-idUSKBN1W51Z9 (Reuters)]
*[[Nicotine marketing]] 
**American retailer [[Walmart]] announces it will stop selling [[electronic cigarettes]], which have recently caused at least eight deaths and 530 cases of a new extreme form of [[respiratory disease]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/09/20/business/walmart-e-cigarettes-vaping/index.html (CNN)]
;Disasters and accidents
*A bus carrying [[China|Chinese]] tourists overturns near [[Bryce Canyon]] [[national park]] in [[Utah]], [[United States]]. At least four passengers are killed and another five wounded. The [[National Transportation Safety Board]] launches an investigation. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2019/sep/21/chinese-tourists-killed-in-utah-bus-crash (''The Guardian'')] [https://twitter.com/NTSB_Newsroom/status/1175165832395182094 (NTSB)]
;International relations
*[[Foreign relations of Taiwan]]
**[[Taiwan]] severs diplomatic relations with [[Kiribati]], according to Taiwanese Foreign Minister [[Joseph Wu]]. Only the [[Marshall Islands]], [[Nauru]], [[Palau]] and [[Tuvalu]] maintain formal relations with Taiwan in the Pacific. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/399237/taiwan-cuts-ties-with-kiribati (RNZ)]
*[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] demands that European allies, in particular [[Germany]] and [[France]], take back captured [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] fighters, or else, he says, "we're going to let them go at your border". Trump also made the same threat in August. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/trump-threatens-to-release-is-captives-at-european-borders/ar-AAHB5fW (AFP via MSN News)]
*[[United States sanctions against Iran]], [[2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack]]
**The United States unveils the "highest sanctions ever imposed on a country", targeting Iran's [[Central Bank of Iran|Central Bank]] and its [[National Development Fund of Iran|National Development Fund]]. [https://www.politico.com/story/2019/09/20/trump-sanctions-irans-central-bank-1506558 (Politico)]
**The head of the Iranian Central Bank says the "re-boycotting" of the already-blacklisted institution shows the U.S.' failure to find new ways to pressure Iran. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-aramco-usa-iran-governor/iran-central-bank-head-says-new-sanctions-show-u-s-failure-idUSKBN1W52BI (Reuters)]
;Law and crime
*A woman who previously accused late United States financier [[Jeffrey Epstein]] of sexually abusing her when she was a teenager says she was "[[human trafficking|trafficked]]" to [[Prince Andrew]] of the [[United Kingdom]] and was abused by him at a house in [[London]]. She calls him "an abuser" and "a participant". Prince Andrew denies the allegations. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-49774539 (BBC News)]
;Politics and elections
*[[September 2019 climate strikes]]
**Millions of young people take to the streets and numerous businesses worldwide go on strike days before the [[2019 UN Climate Action Summit|UN Climate Summit]], demanding that further action be taken to confront [[Global warming|climate change]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-climate-change-strike/students-begin-global-climate-strike-with-message-for-governments-do-your-job-idUSKBN1W507I (Reuters)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/globyal-climate-strike-which-companies-are-closing-their-doors-n1055621 (NBC News)]
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**The [[Mayor of New York City]] [[Bill de Blasio]] announces he is ending his [[Bill de Blasio 2020 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]], saying "I feel like I have contributed all I can to this primary election, and it's clearly not my time". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-49766266 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Egyptian protests]]
**Thousands of protestors march across [[Egypt]], including at [[Tahrir Square]], demanding the resignation of [[President of Egypt|President]] [[Abdel Fattah el-Sisi]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/egypt-thousands-streets-demanding-sisi-resignation-190920205701643.html (Al-Jazeera)]
;Science and technology
*[[Twitter suspensions]]
**[[Twitter]] suspends a network of 4,258 accounts using fake names being operated from the [[United Arab Emirates]] that were spreading [[fake news]] and propaganda, mostly about [[Qatar]] and the war in [[Yemen]]. Twitter also suspends the account of [[Saud al-Qahtani]] for violating the company's "platform manipulation" policies. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/twitter-suspends-thousands-fake-accounts-uae-190920083258996.html (Al Jazeera)]
